title: Rwanda FDA duplicate-register decision ledger
summary: The synchronized 51-group product and pharmacy duplicate ledger is complete and bound to deterministic source comparisons, but every regulatory decision, rationale and named reviewer field remains pending.

checks.name: Synchronized review population
checks.detail: The governed CSV contains exactly 51 rows matching the six duplicate pharmaceutical-product registration groups and 45 duplicate pharmacy professional-registration groups in the current source releases.

checks.name: Deterministic reviewer packet
checks.detail: The source-comparison packet binds the exact product, retail-pharmacy and online-pharmacy release digests and provides field-level comparisons for all 51 groups.

checks.name: No inferred regulatory decision
checks.detail: The packet and verifier deliberately provide no merge, removal, acceptance or correction recommendation; only a named regulatory data reviewer may decide each group.

checks.name: Strict duplicate review
checks.detail: All 51 rows remain pending. The strict verifier will fail until every row records either accepted_source_duplicate or blocked_source_correction with a named reviewer, timezone-qualified timestamp and substantive rationale.

checks.name: Named reviewer completion
checks.detail: The accountable regulatory data reviewer must complete all row decisions, rerun the strict verifier and sign this redacted ledger.

completion_instructions: Review every group in desktop-output/goal-progress-2026-07-16/04-duplicate-review-packet.json against the authoritative Rwanda FDA source.
Record exactly one governed decision, named reviewer, timezone-qualified reviewed_at value and substantive note for every row in data/imports/duplicate-register-review.csv.
Use blocked_source_correction when an authoritative correction is still required; do not change or remove source rows merely to satisfy the verifier.
Run npm run data:duplicates:verify -- --strict and retain its redacted passing result.
Update the review CSV and packet digests, set pending_records to zero, reconcile decision_counts, add reviewer metadata, set every check to passed and set status to complete.
Validate this artifact strictly, add its exact SHA-256 to data/launch-evidence.json and confirm the gate only with named gate approval metadata.
